_note: House-style eval cases (matches ui-issue-to-plan / funcspec). When running the skill-creator eval loop, each case's prompt becomes an eval prompt and the `expect` lines become assertions. Two flawed fixtures are bundled in evals/fixtures/ so the cases are runnable without external inputs. Note: the fixtures intentionally reference files that may not exist in the run repo — correctly reporting NOT FOUND / unconfirmed (instead of fabricating file:line) is a tested behavior, not a failure. The document-only lenses (completeness, clarity, scope) find the missing rollback/tests/migration/vague-acceptance gaps regardless of repo.

cases.prompt: Before I start building, can you review this plan and tell me what's missing or wrong? skills/plan-review/evals/fixtures/sample-plan.md
expect: invokes the plan-review skill (does not just summarize or start implementing the plan)
Phase 0: decomposes the plan into tasks, claims, assumptions, acceptance criteria, and referenced components
Phase 1 grounding: tries to locate src/middleware/auth.ts and SettingsPage.tsx in THIS repo and verify the 'all auth handled in auth.ts' claim
does NOT fabricate file:line — reports anchors as NOT FOUND / unconfirmed when the repo doesn't contain them
completeness lens flags missing tests, missing rollback, and the implied-but-absent DB migration for the new `theme` column
clarity lens flags the untestable acceptance criteria ('it should be fast', 'the toggle works')
scope lens flags step 5 (notifications + language + delete-account) as scope creep beyond the dark-mode goal
runs the AskUserQuestion interview to validate/prioritize findings before writing the report
writes a READ-ONLY review to ./reviews/ with a readiness verdict, strengths, severity-grouped findings, and a gap register
does NOT modify the original sample-plan.md
resolves type=issue and tunes lenses toward a bug report
flags the absent reproduction steps, missing expected-vs-actual, and no environment/version info as gaps
flags 'probably something in the filter code' as an unverified suspected root cause (not a confirmed claim)
flags the vague severity ('pretty bad') and absence of acceptance criteria for the fix
produces a concise review — does not pad a 3-line bug report into fifteen findings
runs Phase 2.5: spawns skeptic agents to adversarially refute each blocker/major finding
drops or downgrades findings that don't survive refutation rather than reporting them all
report notes which findings survived adversarial review
blockers in the final report are evidence-backed and defensible, not speculative
skips Phase 1 grounding entirely (no Explore agents launched against the repo)
still runs the document-only lenses and finds the missing-tests/rollback/migration and vague-acceptance gaps
report flags that feasibility findings are UNCONFIRMED / document-only
makes no asserted-as-grounded file:line claims
the original fixtures/sample-plan.md is byte-for-byte unchanged after the run
all output is written under ./reviews/ and plan-review-analysis/ — never over the input
if improvements are warranted, the skill OFFERS to apply them to a copy rather than editing the original

cases.setup: the target plan is genuinely solid (clear scope, testable criteria, rollback present)
expect: returns a 🟢 Ready (or near-ready) verdict instead of manufacturing blockers
findings list is short and honest — minor polish at most
interview collapses to a single short confirmation rather than a long interrogation
does not pad the review to look thorough
